provenance.dpm_state: high-forced (power_dpm_force_performance_level=high; warm DPM-warmup protocol per docs/methodology/perf-benchmarking.md)
provenance._note: RX 5700 XT / gfx1010 (RDNA1), hipx zoo card, WARM force-high mclk sweep, 2026-07-02. Static fields (vgprs_per_simd=1024, max_waves_per_simd=20, lds_bytes_per_cu=65536, wavefront_size=32) are read directly from the single source of truth profiler.rs::arch_spec('gfx1010'|'gfx1011'|'gfx1012' RDNA1 arm) + ArchCaps::is_wave32() — not hand-recalled. cu_count=40 is from rocminfo/KFD topology on the live card (matches profiler.rs's detect_with_hint 'gfx1010'=>40 fallback, but sourced live, not from that fallback const). vram_mb=8192 (8GB RX 5700 XT). mem_latency_ns=276.058 is MEASURED WARM via pointer_chase_latency (128 MiB single-thread dependent-load chase) at power_dpm_force_performance_level=high, i.e. mclk locked to its highest DPM state, per the mandatory DPM-warmup rule (cold-first profiling is 3-7x slower and non-representative). peak_bw_gbps=384.1 is the DRAM-bound large-buffer PLATEAU from the peak_bw_probe multi-tier sweep (chip_profile::detect_bw_tiers on the warm curve), i.e. the correct roofline denominator — RDNA1 has no on-die Infinity Cache (profiler.rs::arch_spec sets infinity_cache_mb=0.0 for this arch family), so this plateau is effectively the whole achievable range. cache_bw_gbps/effective_cache_mib are null (withheld), NOT a probe failure: the sweep's small-buffer row peaked at 351.8 GB/s, which is BELOW the 384.1 GB/s DRAM plateau, not above it. Per the detect_bw_tiers refinement (2026-07-02, this same day's fix): a sub-plateau row is only reported as a real 'cache tier' when its peak BW EXCEEDS the DRAM plateau (a genuine on-chip cache must be faster than DRAM to represent a meaningful distinct tier) — 351.8 < 384.1 is just sub-saturated small-buffer ramp-up noise on a chip with no Infinity Cache, not a cache-resident bandwidth advantage, so detect_bw_tiers correctly withholds cache_bw_gbps/effective_cache_mib here instead of fabricating a fake 'cache tier' out of a slower row. See detect_bw_tiers_gfx1010_sub_dram_row_is_not_a_cache_tier in chip_profile.rs for the regression test covering exactly this case.
